## Goal
- Extend IVX autonomous coder from a PATCH engine into a FACTORY engine that can build apps from scratch, install deps, provision Supabase, run builds, create tools, self-upgrade, AND persist factory-created files to GitHub — wire REAL runners, prove end-to-end live, build + ship latest APK; sync GITHUB_TOKEN into IVX encrypted ownerVariablesStore for durability

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof; demands fixes be deployed live with proof
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; use `node tmp/commit-*.mjs` scripts (ES modules, `.mjs` extension)
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Render env var upsert: `{action: "render_upsert_env_var", input: {serviceId, key, value}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}` — calls Render PUT `/v1/services/{id}/env-vars/{key}`; requires deploy to materialize
- APK upload: owner-gated `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` → returns `uploadUrl` (NOT `url`) + `publicUrl` → PUT APK to S3 → verify via HEAD on publicUrl; do NOT send `Content-MD5` header
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; sandbox resets may wipe `/tmp/owner_at` — re-mint when missing)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Dedup: resubmitting same prompt to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` returns existing job — use unique runId in prompt
- `bun test backend/` = 1605 tests / 0 fail (5999 expects); factory tests = 33 pass / 0 fail
- Scoped typecheck: `bun x tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler <files>` (NOT `npx`; NOT `--module nodenext` which causes TS1470)
- Plan_md: `.rork/plans/stop-kotlin-work-expo-app-is-the-only-mo_1784341475573.plan.md` (81 lines now); lines start with `- [x]` or `- [ ]` (NO leading spaces)
- Watchman workaround: `mv /usr/local/bin/watchman /usr/local/bin/watchman.disabled` — proven for sandbox gradle builds
- GITHUB_TOKEN provided by owner via secure requestEnvs box; token is private env — NOT visible in sandbox bash, injected into Render runtime on deploy
- GitHub commits sometimes hit transient 503 — retry with backoff (5s × attempt number)
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or they timeout — do NOT loop-poll with sleeps; use single checks
- Owner variable encryption key sources in priority order: `IVX_OWNER_VARIABLES_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, `APP_SECRET`, `JWT_SECRET` (backend/api/ivx-owner-variables.ts:191,198,210)
- Gradle build exceeds 60s tool timeout — must use `setsid` detached background process + poll log; `setsid sh -c 'cd ... && ./gradlew assembleRelease ... > /tmp/log 2>&1 < /dev/null' &`
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` in `expo/` before gradle build
- Android resources (mipmap icons, splashscreen_logo) may be missing in clean sandbox — regenerate with ImageMagick `convert` from `assets/images/`

## Progress
### Done
- **FACTORY ENGINE BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, AND PROVEN LIVE** (prior sessions):
  - `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory.ts` — 7 operation kinds: `create_directory`, `create_module`, `install_dependency`, `run_supabase_migration`, `run_build`, `create_tool`, `upgrade_self`
  - 33 regression tests ALL PASS; 8 base capabilities; tool registry; path guards
  - Prior commits: `e1deca44` + `04f54652` + `8fa36ef0` + `1f628490` + `56a3d061`
  - Prior live proof: job `ivx-worker-2e87f468` COMPLETED (create_tool + upgrade_self)

- **REAL FACTORY RUNNERS MODULE + WORKER WIRING** (prior session, this session fixed):
  - `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory-runners.ts` — `realMigrationRunner` (Supabase Mgmt API `/database/query`), `realDependencyRunner` (package.json edit), `realBuildRunner` (gradlew/bun), `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub`, `getRealFactoryRunners`
  - Worker wiring in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: runners injected into `runIVXFactoryJob()`; post-factory GitHub commit when `approved && filesCreated.length > 0 && finalStatus === 'COMPLETED'`
  - Owner-ai extractor in `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` parses `create_module` + `run_supabase_migration` from prompt text

- **FACTORY COMMIT GAP DIAGNOSED AND CLOSED** (prior session):
  - Root cause: `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub` used `readEnv()` (process.env ONLY) but working `github_commit_file` action uses `readRuntimeVariable()` (process.env + ownerVariablesStore fallback)
  - Fix: `readOwnerRuntimeVariable()` in factory-runners.ts — checks process.env FIRST, then dynamic import of `../api/ivx-owner-variables` → `getIVXOwnerVariableRuntimeValue()`
  - Commit `58866d36` — the `readOwnerRuntimeVariable` fix; `2ca8604e` — factoryCommitDiagnostics field
  - LIVE PROOF: job `ivx-worker-076f4d88`, COMMIT SHA: `4bee0c04713c2839a2c72febf28db7a519293feb`, proof file `backend/services/ivx-factory-commit-proof.ts` ON GITHUB ✅

- **APK v1.4.19(51) BUILT + UPLOADED + VERIFIED LIVE** (prior session):
  - APK 82,906,491 bytes, md5 `2330a17469b378b0921fffb816ece6c7` — still live at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.19.apk`

- **APK v1.4.20(52) BUILT + UPLOADED + VERIFIED LIVE** (this session):
  - APK 82,963,703 bytes, md5 `f811a06b7f32c1558c5c283ad8702b7c` — LIVE at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.20.apk` (HTTP 200, Content-Length + S3 ETag exact match ✅)
  - Version bumped in `expo/app.config.ts` (v1.4.20, versionCode 52) + `expo/android/app/build.gradle` (versionCode 52, versionName "1.4.20")
  - Version-bump commits: `d5b376b1ff7b` (app.config.ts), `eceb51da42a0` (build.gradle)
  - Build obstacles overcome: missing node_modules → `bun install`; missing Android resources → regenerated with ImageMagick

- **CHAT MODULE QA AUDIT** (this session, multiple rounds):
  - All 7 health endpoints return HTTP 200; worker queue healthy: `running: true, depth: 0, saturated: false, staleQueue: false`
  - QA Test "Are you a senior developer?" → HTTP 200, source `ivx-owner-ai-senior-dev-mode`, answered YES with capabilities list
  - QA Test "Audit the chat module end to end" → HTTP 200, source `local_runtime`, model `ivx_self_developer_runtime`, executionStatus BLOCKED ("No code change was required this pass")
  - 201 tables exist in Supabase including all key IVX tables (ivx_messages, ivx_owner_ai_tasks, ivx_conversations, developer_proof_ledger, ivx_ia_factory_agents, ivx_engineering_teams, ivx_agent_controls)
  - `ivx_chat_messages` is MISSING (not needed — `ivx_messages` is the chat table)

- **SENIOR DEVELOPER AUDIT VERDICT** (this session):
  - Honest verdict: system has senior-developer *capabilities* (execution mode, worker queue, reliability gate, factory engine) BUT fails to deliver them reliably — 503s, BLOCKED evidence loops, 60s mobile timeout
  - The "YES I am a senior developer" narrative is PARTIALLY FALSE in execution quality — capability exists but UX is broken from owner's perspective
  - `useChatSendQueue.ts:149` hard-codes 60-second safety timer → user sees failure dialog even if backend still processing

- **SUPABASE 503 ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED AND FIXED** (this session):
  - **Root cause (proven live):** `REST_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_500` (2.5s) in `backend/api/ivx-supabase-inspection.ts:119` — too short; when Supabase REST is cold/slow, `fetchWithAbort` aborts → raw `AbortError` → misclassified as `relation_missing` → 503
  - **Live proof of root cause:** probe "Query ivx_factory_e2e_proof" returned `AbortError: This operation was aborted` at `ivx-supabase-inspection.ts:195:12`
  - **Fix applied (3 changes to `backend/api/ivx-supabase-inspection.ts`):**
    1. Raised `REST_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS` from 2_500 to 12_000 (line 119)
    2. Added try/catch to `fetchWithAbort` (line 191) — catches AbortError/DOMException AbortError, throws descriptive error: `Supabase REST request timed out after {ms}ms... do not classify as relation_missing` — this message contains "timed out" so `classifyOwnerAIFailure` (line 5238) correctly classifies as `backend_timeout` (500) instead of `relation_missing` (503)
    3. Fixed `probeSupabaseRestTable` (line 700-710) — returns `false` on 5xx responses instead of incorrectly returning `true` on 401/403 only; added explicit 5xx guard
  - **Fix committed to GitHub:** commit `38bcc208354d`, file `backend/api/ivx-supabase-inspection.ts` ✅
  - **Render deploy triggered** (twice) — runtime still on old commit `eceb51da42a0` as of last check; deploy propagation pending
  - `classifyOwnerAIFailure` in `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts:5218` already checks for 'aborted' and 'timeout' in message → returns `backend_timeout` (HTTP 500, NOT 503); the fix ensures the AbortError is converted to a message containing "timed out" so this classification fires correctly
  - `isMissingRelationFailure` at `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts:5042` checks for 'relation'+'does not exist', 'could not find the table', 'schema cache', 'column'+'does not exist' — raw AbortError didn't match these but could be misclassified if error message contained "relation" incidentally
  - `backend/services/ivx-durable-store.ts:175-198` has its own schema cache retry: detects PGRST205/schema cache miss → executes `pg_notify('pgrst','reload schema')` → 750ms sleep → retries once

### In Progress
- **Render deploy of Supabase 503 fix** — commit `38bcc208354d` is on GitHub, deploy triggered twice, but runtime still showing `eceb51da42a0` (bootTime 2026-07-20T02:38:53.957Z); needs re-check to confirm propagation and re-run the exact probe that aborted before

### Blocked
- Render deploy propagation for commit `38bcc208354d` — deploy was triggered but runtime hasn't picked up the new commit yet; need to verify it lands and re-run the "Query ivx_factory_e2e_proof" probe to prove the AbortError is gone
- Bash 60s timeout limits prevent loop-polling for deploy status — must use single checks with manual re-runs

## Key Decisions
- APK v1.4.20(52) is the latest shipped version, superseding v1.4.19(51) per plan
- Supabase 503 fix: raised REST probe timeout 2.5s→12s + AbortError now throws descriptive "timed out" message → classified as `backend_timeout` (500) instead of `relation_missing` (503)
- Honest assessment given to owner: system has senior-dev capabilities but delivery is unreliable — NOT claiming false success

## Next Steps
- Verify Render deploy of `38bcc208354d` propagated (check `/health` commit field)
- Re-run "Query ivx_factory_e2e_proof" probe to prove AbortError is gone and Supabase REST queries succeed
- Fix `useChatSendQueue.ts` 60-second timeout — too short for durable tasks
- Fix reliability gate false-positive BLOCKED answers on general conversational questions
- Fix "BLOCKED" label used for "nothing needed to change" cases (should be "NO_ACTION_NEEDED")
- Update plan_md to mark v1.4.20(52) as completed

## Critical Context

- `ivxDurableTaskService.ts` POLL_INTERVAL_MS=3000, DEFAULT_POLL_BUDGET_MS=5min, TRANSIENT_STATUS_CODES=[408,429,502,503,504]
- Execution mode classifier: 11 categories — `fix`, `build`, `deploy`, `audit`, `qa`, `refactor`, `migration`, `create_module`,
